subject: Add the Jev pr check for pull request and commit message coherence
message:
Add the Jev pr check for pull request and commit message coherence

Compares the PR body, ticked template checklist items and each commit
message against the diff stat and changed file list, and renders a
non-blocking advisory comment block.

Verified: python3 -m unittest tools.jev.tests.test_pr (42 tests, exit 0)
and a live run over HEAD~3..HEAD.
